temporal_state_chain.observed: Gary has been working excessively long hours at the hospital, often skipping meals and sacrificing sleep. When Ethan invites him to a weekend retreat, Gary declines, saying there is too much to do at the hospital.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is a dedicated hospital worker and longtime friend, but does not yet know the full reasons for Gary's overwork.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Ethan's concern is confirmed and deepened: Gary's overwork is serious, and Gary feels unable to step away because of hospital obligations.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is overworked, neglecting his health, and currently unwilling or unable to take a break because of work demands.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To intervene supportively and help Gary find a way to rest and protect his health.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During the retreat, Gary is restless and avoids discussions about work. When Ethan confronts him, Gary says it is complicated and that he did not want to burden Ethan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Gary is overworked due to hospital demands, is neglecting his health, and initially resisted taking a break.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Ethan now suspects Gary's overwork involves deeper, complicated issues beyond routine professional obligations, and Gary has been withholding them to avoid burdening him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is carrying complicated problems he has not shared; his overwork is not just a simple scheduling issue, and he may need nonjudgmental support to open up.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To encourage Gary to open up and reassure him that he can share without judgment.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Gary opens up about the pressures of managing a new department and the personal challenges he is facing. Gary agrees to try prioritizing tasks and delegating responsibilities.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Gary is hiding complicated personal and professional burdens and needs help to open up.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Ethan learns the specific reasons behind Gary's overwork: new department pressures and personal challenges. He also sees a practical path to help Gary rebalance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary's overwork is understandable given concrete pressures and personal challenges; with planning and delegation, Gary can begin to find better balance.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Gary organize his schedule, prioritize tasks, delegate responsibilities, and find a healthier work-life balance.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over the following months, Ethan regularly checks in with Gary and sees Gary making efforts to change. Gary reports feeling better, less overwhelmed, and having had time for a movie.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Gary is working toward better balance with Ethan's support, but still faces challenges and needs ongoing encouragement.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Ethan sees that Gary's efforts are producing real progress and that Gary is becoming less overwhelmed.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is making meaningful progress toward a healthier balance and is benefiting from Ethan's ongoing support.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue checking in, offering support and encouragement, and discussing challenges as Gary progresses.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After a year, Gary has successfully adjusted to a healthier work-life balance and is managing on his own. Gary thanks Ethan and says he feels more in control.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Gary has been improving and still benefits from Ethan's support and check-ins, though he is increasingly capable.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Ethan concludes that Gary can now maintain his healthier balance independently and no longer needs active intervention.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary has successfully adjusted, is capable of managing on his own, and knows Ethan remains available if needed.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To step back from active support while letting Gary know he can still call if needed.
